What I do

Software engineering for a messy world

Off-the-shelf software often fails when business logic gets complicated. I build custom, bespoke digital solutions that bridge the gap between fragmented data and operational clarity.

Whether it's automating manual workflows or digitising a decade of paper records, I bring a structured approach to your most tangled technical challenges.

Flagship project

FosterRoster, one login for a whole rescue

A multi-tenant platform for animal rescue and foster organisations, from a newborn litter's daily weigh-ins to a signed, invoiced adoption contract. It started as bespoke builds for individual rescues and became one product, white-labelled for any Australian rescue.
